enum.name: DRONE_COMPONENT
enum.description: Thiet bi tren drone duoc theo doi.

entry.name: DRONE_COMPONENT_RADIO
entry.description: Radio SiK 433 tren drone: rate_hz = byte/s gui xuong, state = "BUF xx%" (bo dem phat con trong, txbuf cua RADIO_STATUS).

enum.name: DRONE_COMPONENT_LEVEL
enum.description: Muc tinh trang, cung gia tri voi diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticStatus.

entry.name: DRONE_COMPONENT_LEVEL_OK
entry.description: San sang / hoat dong binh thuong.

entry.name: DRONE_COMPONENT_LEVEL_WARN
entry.description: Dang chay nhung co van de.

entry.name: DRONE_COMPONENT_LEVEL_STALE
entry.description: Khong nhan duoc thong tin tu node (node chet / chua chay).

message.name: DRONE_COMPONENT_STATUS
message.description: Trang thai hien tai va tan so hoat dong cua mot thiet bi tren drone.
message.field: Tan so hoat dong do duoc (0 neu khong co du lieu).
Trang thai dang chu, vd STREAMING, READY, DISCONNECTED.

message.name: DRONE_LOCAL_POSE
message.description: Vi tri + tu the cuc bo cua drone (PX4 vehicle_odometry qua uXRCE-DDS tren Jetson), de ground station ve 3D. Frame NED cua EKF PX4 (goc = noi EKF khoi tao), giu nguyen quy uoc PX4; ground doi sang ENU khi ve.
message.field: Vi tri Down (am = cao hon goc).
Quaternion w, x, y, z: FRD (than drone) -> NED.
Tang khi EKF dat lai vi tri (nhay vi tri) -- ground xoa vet bay.

message.name: DRONE_GIMBAL_STATE
message.description: Goc gimbal Skydroid tu Jetson (/gimbal_state, skydroid_msgs/GimbalState) -- goc do gimbal bao, so voi than drone.
